pages.text_original: Livhu is a happy girl who enjoys soaking up the sun and watching flowers bloom brightly in her garden. She also enjoys going outside in her wheelchair.
When she is outside, some people stare at her. “Aww!” they say, feeling sorry for her.
“But I want to stay and talk to people,” Livhu says to the cashier who wheels her to the front of the line in the spaza shop.
“May we push you down the slope?” offer some of the kids in the park.
“Swishhhh!” Livhu feels the fresh air whip across her face as they go down the hill.
Livhu knows people want to help, BUT...
...mostly she likes to do things for herself.
At the spaza shop she enjoys chatting to people in the line and making new friends. “Hi! I am Livhu.”
Back in the park, she joins in a fun game of tug-of-war with the other children.
Livhu is so happy. Her wheelchair helps her have fun with her favourite people.
At night she falls asleep thinking about more great adventures to have with her wheelchair and her new besties.
